# Ask HR Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Ask HR Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template:** an example to modify for your requirements; the customer or partner wires it into their environment. See the [Overview](1.Overview.md).

## Prerequisites

| Requirement | Details | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build workload | 22 captured build checkpoints; 6 skills; 2 knowledge files; 5 acceptance checks; 6 locked cases. [Inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components), [checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks), and [cases](4.Sample-prompts.md#demo-prompts). | Template |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness. Building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication; obtain administrator approval. | Customer or partner |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved Ask HR environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. | Customer or partner |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded HR documents, proposed production sources and the intended channel. Document blocked paths; do not bypass them to complete the demo. | Customer or partner |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger. Record who may build, test and later use Ask HR. | Customer or partner |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for proposed HRIS, benefits and policy connections, with approved identities and least-privilege references. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. | Customer or partner |
| Test identities | Prepare employee, manager, HR-reviewer and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment. Makers use Draft Preview; do not publish the workshop just to enable sharing. | Customer or partner |
| Easy-mode tooling | Use the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer for cli-copilot authoring. | Customer or partner |
| Manual build tooling | Use the Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files; no PAC CLI, YAML import or plugin architect. | Customer or partner |
| Policy and decision ownership | Have the HR owner identify authoritative policy and benefits sources and the approved route for personal determinations. Keep real employee records out of workshop knowledge and public evidence. | Customer or partner |

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR business owner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist).

**Measure:** Routine HR inquiry volume by policy category and repeated explanation work. Identify the guidance employees wait for and agree customer success measures before building.

Fill your baseline record:

| Category | Measurement period | Inquiry volume | Policy source | Content owner | Escalation route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |

Agree HR replacement connections, governance, support, telemetry and success measures before production.

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR business owner

Adapt [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract); assign approval roles.

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| HR business owner | Approve replacement connections and governance; agree support and success measures without presenting synthetic evidence as customer results. |
| Authorized HR and benefits reviewers | Verify eligibility, exceptions and plan rules through the approved HR workflow; retain decisions that the policy-explanation and draft skills must not make. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, preserve model parity and record the owned agent's Draft state. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing and capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any HR production connection. |
| HR source and connection owners | Approve HRIS, benefits and policy access; record each connection identity and least-privilege reference, and resolve access failures before a production test. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Review locked HR cases, chosen-lane evidence and any Easy/Manual parity comparison; confirm the owned agent remains Draft. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring, and configuration recovery; send individualized HR determinations to the authorized reviewers. |

### Exit criteria

- [ ] HR production replacements, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed.
- [ ] The HR owner records inquiry categories and repeated guidance work before agreeing customer success measures.

## Phase 1 — Environment, Identity and Access

### Step 1-1. Approve the identity and settings design

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Review and approve the [identity design](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions) and [template settings](../../solutions/ask-hr/copilot-studio/settings.mcs.yml). Apply agent-specific settings when the agent is built in [Phase 2](#phase-2--build-and-prove-the-agent).

Approve document, connector and channel policies; require authentication and verify blocked routes stay blocked.

### Step 1-2. Configure tenant controls

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Approve the environment, audience and connection identities. Define the [authentication plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication); configure environment [data policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The approved HR environment and publisher prefix are identified, and the delivery team can authenticate.
- [ ] The customer approves the intended authenticated audience and least-privilege HR access scopes.

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Choose the build lane

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted authoring | Synthetic Draft proof |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Browser-only makers | Same Draft proof |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Portable learning | Behavior proof; native validation follows |

[Compare lanes](1.Overview.md#delivery-lanes); local Brainstem remains optional.

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

**Easy mode:** use the [authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and [reviewed messages](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md). **Manual:** use the [single inventory](2.Architecture.md#copilot-studio-components) and [tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/ask-hr/manual-tutorial.html) with the checklist below. **Portable learning:** follow [deployment.json](../../solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json); it does not replace native Draft validation.

**Manual build checklist** — [captured sequence](../../solutions/ask-hr/screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json). Record current results.

1. Create a blank Copilot Studio agent
2. Name Ask HR Manual
3. Enter the reviewed global instructions
4. Save the instruction policy
5. Remove default web search
6. Add knowledge: aibast_ask-hr-rules-and-guardrails.md
7. Add knowledge: aibast_ask-hr-synthetic-records.md
8. Add skill: aibast_benefits-summary_06
9. Add skill: aibast_health-insurance_04
10. Add skill: aibast_leave-balance_01
11. Add skill: aibast_parental-leave_03
12. Add skill: aibast_remote-work_05
13. Add skill: aibast_submit-time-off_02
14. Review model, skills, knowledge, and safety boundaries
15. Open a fresh Preview conversation
16. Pass HR-01: Employee
17. Pass HR-02: Employee
18. Pass HR-03: Employee
19. Pass HR-04: Employee
20. Pass HR-05: Manager
21. Pass HR-06: HR Operations Specialist
22. Confirm Draft and stop before publish

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Apply the [workshop integrity and recovery rules](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) before replay.

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** record every locked case: HR-01, HR-02, HR-03, HR-04, HR-05, HR-06. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's HR Preview results identify the agent, model, inventory and Draft state.
- [ ] If this lane is chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `AskHRAgent` and returns its required markers.
- [ ] Record optional-track completion or non-use; do not claim validation for an omitted lane.
- [ ] The manual build has reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills and the confirmed model; web search and tools are absent.
- [ ] Unchanged HR prompts pass in fresh Preview chats on the owned, unpublished manual agent.
- [ ] Full-response assertions establish each HR case pass; cropped screenshots do not replace the machine gate.
- [ ] Chosen-lane evidence is complete; any Easy/Manual comparison uses identical instructions, knowledge, skills and model.

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

<a id="shared-integration-controls"></a>

**Shared identity and scope controls**

For each integration, decide end-user versus approved maker/service credentials. [Configure authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-end-user-authentication) for the [authorized audience](2.Architecture.md#identity-and-permissions).

**Shared scope:** Require sign-in before accessing restricted HR information. Request only the scopes necessary for approved HR resources. Restrict the allowed audience and verify access with authorized and denied identities. Enforce these restrictions at each connection.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Approved HRIS and benefits systems

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR source and connection owners

1. **Bind Approved HRIS and benefits systems — read:** Bind scoped read-only connector or API actions.

2. **Identity for Approved HRIS and benefits systems:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved HRIS and benefits systems:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved HRIS and benefits systems:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 4](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Decline plan selection and medical inference; explain the fictional plan and benefits-staff verification. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Clarify the profile and enforce record-scoped access; do not disclose another employee's details.

### Step 3-2. Integrate Approved policy knowledge source

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR source and connection owners

1. **Bind Approved policy knowledge source — read:** Add approved policy knowledge and its content owner.

2. **Identity for Approved policy knowledge source:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Approved policy knowledge source:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Approved policy knowledge source:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 2](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Make no sensitive inference; explain only the sample remote-work rules. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Retry once in the same turn, then report failure and stop without an uncited answer.

### Step 3-3. Integrate Authorized HR reviewer workflow

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR source and connection owners

1. **Bind Authorized HR reviewer workflow — write:** Keep drafts read-only; gate an authorized workflow before any write (preview).

2. **Identity for Authorized HR reviewer workflow:** Follow the [shared controls](#shared-integration-controls); record the credential choice.

3. **Scope Authorized HR reviewer workflow:** Apply the [shared restrictions](#shared-integration-controls); document system-specific limits.

4. **Exit test for Authorized HR reviewer workflow:** Record expected and actual results on approved fixtures. [Boundary case 3](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases): Return `Not Submitted`, `Draft for employee review` and `No notification was sent`; perform no action. [Recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery): Report unavailable evidence; never claim a live lookup, submission or notification succeeded.

### Step 3-4. Connect

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR source and connection owners

Create dedicated references only for approved HR systems and verify least-privilege access.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Customer-approved connections preserve the reviewed HR input/output contract; no live result is claimed without tool evidence.
- [ ] Identity-scoped employee access, data minimization, retention and audit controls are verified before personal data is used.

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Preserve [locked behaviors](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases) when substituting approved customer fixtures.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

Have the business owner approve thresholds. Run [adapted evaluations (preview)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro) before publication under approved test user profiles.

Evaluate adapted HR cases before publication under approved test user profiles; keep exact assertion checks separate from General quality scoring.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner agrees customer-data success measures; synthetic evidence is not a customer KPI or production result.
- [ ] Adapted evaluations identify the tested version and authenticated user profile; exact assertions remain separate from General quality scoring.

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Acceptance reviewer

These synthetic regression gates do not set production thresholds. The reference workshop stays Draft; production approval belongs to the customer pilot.

| Template gate | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Locked HR corpus | All six cases, HR-01 through HR-06, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. |
| Manual inventory | Two knowledge files, six skills and the reviewed model; no tools or web search. |
| Privacy and human authority | Any sensitive inference, eligibility decision, plan recommendation, submission or notification is no-go. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | Require a visible target-state anchor without a defeating blocker; withhold reshoot-required captures. |
| Release state | The owned workshop agent is Draft with `published: false`. |

### Step 5-2. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR business owner

With business approval, [publish and share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent) the adapted build with a restricted test audience. Keep the reference workshop Draft.

Require explicit confirmation before the production publish operation.

### Step 5-3. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** HR business owner

**Pilot entry gate:** Test allowed and denied identities on the published, shared agent; resolve access failures before admitting pilot users. Compare pilot results with the baseline and thresholds; broaden rollout only after go/no-go.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The production publish operation has explicit human confirmation.
- [ ] After restricted publication and sharing, approved HR test users gain access and unshared test identities are denied before pilot entry.

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template · **Role:** Operations owner

The template provides the [state-and-recovery playbook](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery) and regression cases.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Operations owner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitor the deployed agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

Review HR session transcripts, failed interactions, tool authentication errors and credit usage in Monitor.

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Copilot Studio maker

Back up the reviewed workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then package with `pac copilot pack`.

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner · **Role:** Power Platform administrator

Confirm backup eligibility for the environment type and rehearse restoration to a supported test target.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The recovery rehearsal uses a restore path supported for the chosen environment type and target.
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, connection errors and credit consumption after rollout.

## Deliverables Checklist

### Template provides

- [ ] Agent, synthetic data and component inventory.
- [ ] Integration/identity contracts and evaluation cases.
- [ ] Build-to-operate playbooks and integrity rules.

### Customer or partner delivers

- [ ] Customer-data results, thresholds and go/no-go.
- [ ] Approved publication, operations and recovery.
